title: The caregiver's number is accepted when it is the elder's own
method: wizard drive giving the same number for the elder and the caregiver
triggers: elder phone and caregiver phone both '307-555-0101'
observed_at_discovery: Config written with phone, emergency_contacts[0].phone and primary_caregiver.phone all '+13075550101', with no prompt or warning. In a shared-landline household -- the normal case when the caregiver lives with the person being called -- every alert and crisis text is addressed to the handset Cura just called. CuraVoice.alert_caregiver also reads the crisis details aloud to whoever answers, which here is the person in crisis.
